div.head: Af 59
div.ab: Gif se goldfinger bið ofaslægen, to ðæm sculon XVII scll' to bote; ⁊ his nægles IIII scll' to bote.
Gif se goldfinger sie ófaslegen, to þam sculon XVII scill. to bote; ⁊ his nægles IIII scill. to bote.
Si quartus qui anularis dicitur amputetur, XVII sol. culpa iudicetur; unguis IIII sol. emendetur.
Gif se goldfinger sie ofaslegen, to þam sculon XVII scill to bote; ⁊ his nægles IIII scill to bote.
If the ring finger175 is struck off, for that 17 shillings shall be compensation; and for its nail 4 shillings as compensation.
If the third finger is struck off, 17 shillings must be paid as compensation for it; and for the nail of the same, 4 shillings [must be paid] as compensation
Wenn der Goldfinger abgeschlagen ist, dafür gehören 17 Schill. zur Busse, und 4 Schill. zu seines Nagels Busse.
If the gold-finger [ring finger] is struck off, 17 shillings are due for it as compensation, and 4 shillings for its nail’s compensation.
